campaigns.summary: Ember Recreational Vehicles, INC (Ember) is recalling certain 2024 E-Series travel trailers equipped with certain power seating assemblies. The power cord fuse may not provide adequate circuit protection.

campaigns.component: FUEL SYSTEM, DIESEL:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
campaigns.summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2022-2024 LFS and 2023 LFS Artic transit buses. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.

Heartland Recreational Vehicles, LLC (Heartland) is recalling certain 2024 Torque, Bighorn, Cyclone, 2022-2023 Gravity, and Road Warrior fifth wheel recreational trailers equipped with certain power seating assemblies. The power cord fuse may not provide adequate circuit protection.
Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain 2027 Champion and Everest van trailers. The trailer landing gear k-brace welds may fail, resulting in the landing gear collapsing.
